name: El Escritor
source:
~Welcome to Lahmbert~

~El Escritor(The Writer in english)~ it's a romance visual novel with a little bit of mystery, suspense and realistic fantasy. You'll be in the skin of Lucas, a guy who has recently moved to the city of Lahmbert searching a new start. However, Destiny has a way of catching up with you, and other plans are being orchestrated for him and the people he's gonna find along the way... And the ones who he left behind.

Lucas starts on the rooftop, his —not so humble, yet amazingly cheap— new apartment. After the first night in the rooftop and meeting his neighbors, there, in the darkest corner, the face of Destiny appears haunting a decision never made, the step never taken... or the one that Lucas actually took. Between dark dreams and a expectant reality, as some may say, expect a roller coaster of emotions. Joy, suspense, melancholy... Emotions at the surface of your skin.

A small story, just like yours or mine, in one of the smallest corners of Lahmbert. 

[From [url=https://sethbaine.itch.io/el-escritor]Itch.io[/url]]
